name: charge_s1
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
lane=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
plan=dict(queries=["treewidth of token graphs of trees Theta(n^(k-1)) conjecture proof"],mode='standard',tool='WebSearch',target='362080',purpose='Prior-art check for the tree token-graph treewidth conjecture (source 2402.17962 Conjecture 20) before any candidate is proposed')
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'plans/search-1.json'],input=json.dumps(plan,indent=1)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True)
print('writer',w.returncode,w.stderr)
if w.returncode: sys.exit(w.returncode)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'charge_search.py'),'plans/search-1.json'],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=str(lane))
print('charge exit',r.returncode);print(r.stdout);print(r.stderr)
sys.exit(r.returncode)
